verdict.rationale: iTerm2 documents a built-in find feature that highlights all matches immediately and supports regular expressions, plus Global Search across all tabs, so searching scrollback is clearly a first-party capability. The evidence never explicitly describes jumping between matches (next/previous navigation), so that half of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of next/previous match navigation, evidence of search speed on large scrollback, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search my scrollback quickly and jump between matches

citations.quote: iTerm2 comes with a robust find-on-page feature. The UI stays out of the way. All matches are immediately highlighted. Even regular expression support is offered!
Search all your tabs at once with Global Search.
